B7F.method: B7F requires formalizing 20 sealed NL texts into .form files, then running the formal battery and checking against sealed verdicts. QUOT has no NL formalizer: it cannot produce .form files from NL text, so there is no formal battery to run and nothing for b7f_checker.py to score.
B7F.score_note: not scoreable: b7f_checker.py requires produced .form files; empty input yields no score, not a zero. Recording null rather than fabricating a number.

note: QUOT is a formal-logic engine: it reads .form files (ID/STORE/PREMISES/TARGET) and emits verdicts. It has no natural-language formalizer and no NL input path. NL batteries are therefore abstentions, recorded honestly rather than scored.
